serverWizardDesc: You are the owner now. Answer a few questions to get your server ready. You can change all of this later in Server Settings.
serverWizardAllowNewUsersQuestion: Can new people register on their own?
serverWizardAllowNewUsersEnable: Anyone who knows the server address can create an account and join.
serverWizardAllowNewUsersDisable: Only people you invite can join. You create invites in Server Settings.
serverWizardPasswordEnable: Everyone must type a shared password before entering the server.
serverWizardPasswordDisable: No extra password, an account is enough to enter.
serverWizardDirectMessagesEnable: Members can talk to each other privately.
serverWizardDirectMessagesDisable: Conversations only happen in the server channels.
serverWizardUploadsEnable: Members can share images and files in their messages.
serverWizardUploadsDisable: Only text can be sent, which saves disk space on the server.
serverWizardPluginsEnable: Installed plugins run on the server and can add commands and features.
serverWizardPluginsDisable: No plugins run, the server only has the built in features.
serverWizardImageOptimizationEnable: Images are converted to smaller WebP files, saving disk space and loading faster.
serverWizardImageOptimizationDisable: Images are stored exactly as they were uploaded.
serverWizardSignedUrlsQuestion: Protect file links with signed URLs?
serverWizardSignedUrlsEnable: File links expire and only work for people allowed to see them, including files in private channels and direct messages.
serverWizardSignedUrlsDisable: Anyone with a file link can open it, even files from private channels and direct messages.
serverWizardMediaProxyQuestion: Load embedded media through the server?
serverWizardMediaProxyEnable: Images and videos from links are fetched by the server, so members' IP addresses stay hidden from the sites they come from. This uses the server's bandwidth.
serverWizardMediaProxyDisable: Embedded media loads straight from the original site, which can see the IP address of everyone who views it.
serverWizardDoneDesc: Welcome to Sharkord. Your server is set up, invite your friends and enjoy!
